learningObjective: Understand that a circle can be decomposed into many thin concentric rings stacked from center outward — the circle isn't a solid blob but layers from the center out
proposition: A circle can be divided into thin concentric rings at every distance from center to edge

miniSpec.title: Building Circle by Radius
miniSpec.manipulated_variable: Dragging the arrow tip outward to increase radius
miniSpec.primary_visual_feedback: New rings paint in as the circle grows with visible ring layers; the outermost ring is highlighted at current radius
miniSpec.goal_structure: Free exploration — drag from center outward to see the complete ring decomposition
miniSpec.causal_chain_exposed: The current radius value displayed, the shaded region inside current radius growing, the outermost highlighted ring at current radius
miniSpec.trace_strategy: All rings remain visible and accumulate, showing the buildup of layers
miniSpec.aha_moment: The circle isn't a solid blob but many thin rings stacked together from center outward

interactionContract.student_changes: drags the radius arrow outward from the center
interactionContract.student_sees: rings paint in one by one as the circle grows

modelVariables.rings_currentRadius: current radius position r (0 to R_max), student-dragged outward from center
modelVariables.rings_ringCount: derived: number of rings that have been painted so far, based on currentRadius / dr
modelVariables.rings_maxRadius: the full circle's radius R (fixed), shown as the outer boundary

assertions.description: On load, the circle is mostly empty — the handle sits near the center, inviting the student to drag outward
assertions.visualCheck: Circle outline visible but interior mostly empty; handle visible near center

assertions.description: The radius arrow handle exists and can be dragged
assertions.visualCheck: A teal draggable handle is visible along the radius line extending from the center

assertions.description: Dragging the radius arrow outward causes rings to paint in one by one
assertions.visualCheck: Multiple concentric rings fill the circle from center to the dragged position; rings accumulate

assertions.description: Dragging to maximum radius fills the entire circle with rings
assertions.visualCheck: Circle is completely filled with concentric rings from center to edge

assertions.description: The outermost ring at the current radius is visually highlighted
assertions.visualCheck: The outermost ring has a thicker or more prominent stroke than inner rings

invariants.description: The number of rings shown is proportional to the current radius
Rings remain visible and accumulate as radius grows (trace strategy)
